children: Polish corporate sector wages (PLWAGE=ECI) rose by an annual 5.6% in August to an average of 9,260 zlotys ($2,437) per month, below analysts' expectations of a 6.4% rise, statistics office data showed on Monday.
In monthly terms, wages fell by 2.6%.
Corporate employment (PLEMPY=ECI) fell 0.8% year-on-year to 6.368 million people in August. Analysts expected corporate employment to fall by 0.8%.
In monthly terms, corporate employment fell 0.2%.
